headline: Sensex crashes 1,484 points, Nifty drops below 25,350 as metal and banking stocks bleed

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Stock market rally took a breather as Sensex dived up to 1,500 points intraday.
Sharp sell-off in metal and PSU banking stocks dragged the market down.
Rupee retreated along with equities after the recent market rally.
Tata Steel experienced heavy selling, ending as the top loser.
whatHappening: Sensex crashed 1,484 points while Nifty 50 ended below the 25,350 mark.
Metal and PSU bank sectors faced heavy selling pressure during the trading session.
Investors check holiday status for BSE and NSE regarding Guru Nanak Jayanti on November 24.
German bond yields edged higher as global equity rebound eased safe-haven demand.
summary: Indian markets suffered a major drop on November 23 as the Sensex crashed 1,484 points and Nifty closed below 25,350. Metal and PSU banking stocks faced severe selling, with Tata Steel emerging as the top loser. The market sell-off also coincided with a retreat in the rupee as the recent rally paused.
